description: This is a Java JUnit test class focused on testing Two-Factor Authentication features of the Apache Fineract server. It includes setup methods, tests for access control, two-factor method retrieval, login with two-factor validation, and configuration management.

classes.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class designed to test the Two-Factor Authentication features of the Fineract platform, including setup, login, configuration changes, and access control.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, authenticates to obtain a basic auth token, and sets up request and response specifications.

methods.name: testActuatorAccess
methods.description: Tests access to the actuator info endpoint.

methods.name: testApiDocsAccess
methods.description: Tests access to the API documentation page.

methods.name: testAccessWithoutTwofactor
methods.description: Verifies access control when two-factor authentication is not enabled.

methods.name: testCheckTwofactorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if two-factor authentication is required for login.

methods.name: testTwofactorLogin
methods.description: Performs a complete two-factor login process, including receiving email token, validation, and access checks.

methods.name: testTfaConfigSettings
methods.description: Tests configuration retrieval and update for two-factor authentication, including OTP length modifications.

methods.name: initializeRestAssured
methods.description: Configures RestAssured for HTTPS connections to the local server.

methods.name: awaitSpringBootActuatorHealthyUp
methods.description: Polls the health endpoint until the application is ready.

methods.name: performServerGet
methods.description: Helper to perform HTTP GET with specified request and response specifications, returning JSON or specified attribute.

methods.name: performServerPost
methods.description: Helper to perform HTTP POST with specified request and response specifications, returning JSON or specified attribute.

methods.name: performServerPut
methods.description: Helper to perform HTTP PUT with specified request and response specifications, returning JSON or specified attribute.
